resources.string: Prepare the card
01 / CONNECT THE CARD
Put a memory card of 8 to 32 GB in a USB card reader, then connect the reader to this phone.
Find the card
02 / CHOOSE THE CARD
Choose your card. Your phone then opens it: choose Use this folder, then Allow.
No card found. Check that the card is in the reader and that the reader is connected to this phone.
Look again
Opening the card…
03 / ERASE THIS CARD
Everything on this card will be erased. Your phone then downloads the DeKoi installer, %1$s, and copies it to the card with your DeKoi’s settings. This takes a few minutes.
Erase this card
04 / PREPARE THE CARD
Downloading
Copying
Checking
Done
%1$s of %2$s
Keep the card connected and stay in this app until the card is ready.
05 / LINK THE CARD
The card is ready. Linking it to your account…
The card is ready, but it is not linked to your account yet.
You can also link it later: go to Add a DeKoi and type this code.
06 / POWER ON
%1$s is linked to your account.
Put the memory card in your DeKoi.
Connect your DeKoi to your router with a network cable.
Connect the power. Your DeKoi now sets itself up while its light blinks. This takes about 10 minutes, then it appears in the app.
Done
THE CARD IS NOT READY
DeKoi needs the whole card. Try again: choose the card itself, not a folder on it, and allow access.
Your phone sees %1$s on this card. Use a memory card of 8 to 32 GB. If this card is larger, it still holds an earlier setup: format it in your phone’s storage settings, then try again.
This card holds %1$s. Your DeKoi can only start from a card of 8 to 32 GB prepared with a phone. Use a smaller card, or prepare this one with DeKoi Setup on a computer.
The card is locked. Slide the small switch on its side up, then try again.
The download stopped. Check your internet connection and try again.
The download arrived damaged. Nothing on the card was changed. Try again.
The phone could not write to the card. Check that the reader is connected and try again.
The card did not keep what was copied to it. Try another card.
